shorts.title: What you will learn: auto, const and constexpr
shorts.script: Some values must never change. Today we learn three keywords. One saves typing, and two protect your values from mistakes. The keyword auto tells the compiler to find the type from the value. The keyword const makes a variable read-only. You cannot change it after you set it. The keyword constexpr is stronger. The value must be known when the program is compiled. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: What you will learn: auto, const and constexpr.

shorts.title: auto, const and constexpr in one minute
shorts.hook: The keyword auto tells the compiler to find the type
shorts.script: The keyword auto tells the compiler to find the type from the value. The keyword const makes a variable read-only. You cannot change it after you set it. The keyword constexpr is stronger. The value must be known when the program is compiled. Think of a sealed jar of masala. You can look at it, but you cannot change what is inside. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: auto, const and constexpr in one minute.

shorts.title: Inside the second program
shorts.script: Pi is a constexpr. The radius is const. We promise not to change it. Auto picks double for the area, because pi and radius are doubles. The area is twelve point five six. The program prints the area, twelve point five six. Auto lets the compiler find the type. Const makes a variable read-only. Constexpr needs a value known at compile time. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Inside the second program.

shorts.title: Bug of the Day: Changing a const
shorts.hook: Can you spot the bug in auto, const and constexpr?
shorts.script: Can you spot the bug in auto, const and constexpr? Bug of the Day. Max seats is const, but line six tries to change it. The compiler says assignment of read-only variable. That is a good error. It stops a real bug before the program runs. Remove the line, or remove const if the value must change. A const variable is read-only. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Bug of the Day: Changing a const.

shorts.title: Pun and challenge
shorts.hook: Can you make a circle program with const in auto
shorts.script: Can you make a circle program with const in auto, const and constexpr? I put a const on my bank balance. Now it will never change, and that is the problem. Use constexpr for pi and const for a radius that you choose. Print the area and the circumference. Write your answer in the comments. Auto lets the compiler find the type. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
